official_sources.name: HM Land Registry title plan guidance
HM Land Registry title plan explanation

direct_official_checks: title plan is read with register and filed documents
general boundary is not exact legal boundary by default
title plan relies on OS mapping current when prepared
title plan is not routinely updated whenever OS mapping changes
plan updates occur for relevant registered changes
later OS building changes do not by themselves move registered extent
quality_effect: Prevents treating a current basemap or later OS feature revision as a current exact parcel boundary.
